question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing sweeper, Bob is playing center midfielder, and Claire is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Alice and Bob trade positions. Finally, Alice and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) sweeper
(B) center midfielder
(C) right winger
solution:
Positions in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (sweeper, center midfielder, right winger)
1. Claire and Alice swap: (right winger, center midfielder, sweeper)
2. Alice and Bob swap: (center midfielder, right winger, sweeper)
3. Alice and Bob swap: (right winger, center midfielder, sweeper)
Claire is playing sweeper, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
